recipes.name: Creamy Red Pesto Gnocchi
ingredients: ⅓ cup plain vegan cream cheese
instructions: Add the oil, shallots and garlic to a medium pot, and cook until lightly golden.
Add the tomatoes and pesto, and cook for 5 to 8 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the gnocchi according to the package instructions. For us this took 2 minutes. Then drain.
Heat some oil a sauté pan over medium-high heat. Add the drained gnocchi to the pan and cook until lightly golden on the outside. Cook in batches if necessary to not over-crowd the pan.
Returning to the sauce, add in the cream cheese, salt, and pepper. Use an immersion blender to blend until smooth*.
Transfer the tomato sauce to the sauté pan containing the gnocchi. Squeeze over the lemon juice, and stir to coat.
Plate, garnish as desired, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes * Alternatively, blend in a standing blender.

Storage The gnocchi is best enjoyed freshly made. Store leftovers in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 1 day - any longer and the gnocchi tends to become overly firm. Ideally, reheat in a pan with a splash of water to loosen the sauce and gnocchi up.
